units.n: Unit 1 — Basic Biochemistry and Cell Organisation
subs: Chemical elements are joined together to form biological compounds
Biological reactions are regulated by enzymes
Genetic information is copied and passed on to daughter cells

units.n: Unit 2 — Biodiversity and Physiology of Body Systems
subs: All organisms are related through their evolutionary history

units.n: Unit 3 — Energy, Homeostasis and the Environment
subs: Photosynthesis uses light energy to synthesise organic molecules
Respiration releases chemical energy in biological processes
